display_long_description:
Get behind the wheel and experience the ultimate off-road adventure in Off-Road Racing & Driving Simulator. Explore rugged mountains, muddy trails, rocky roads, steep hills, desert tracks, and challenging terrain while testing your driving skills in immersive virtual reality.

Drive a variety of powerful off-road vehicles, each with unique handling and realistic physics. Race against AI opponents, complete exciting driving challenges, and conquer extreme environments designed to push your skills to the limit. Whether you enjoy high-speed off-road racing or carefully navigating difficult trails, every journey offers a new challenge.

Realistic vehicle controls, detailed environments, and immersive VR gameplay make every race feel authentic. Climb steep hills, cross rivers, avoid obstacles, and master dangerous roads as you become the ultimate off-road driver.

Features
Realistic off-road driving and racing experience
Immersive VR gameplay designed for Meta Quest
Multiple off-road vehicles with unique handling
Challenging mountain, forest, desert, and muddy tracks
Realistic vehicle physics and smooth controls
Exciting racing and driving missions
Beautiful environments with dynamic terrain
Progressive difficulty for beginners and experienced drivers
Optimized performance for a smooth VR experience

Take on the toughest roads, improve your driving skills, and prove you have what it takes to become the ultimate off-road racing champion.
